rationale: SMB bookkeeping automation is a large, underserved category and the timing is right — QuickBooks/Xero haven't moved fast on AI-native workflows. Early traction (300 customers, 18% MoM) suggests real category-creation pull.
conviction_points: Large underserved SMB accounting category with weak incumbent AI response
18% MoM growth with no paid acquisition suggests organic category pull
Founding team has domain credibility (ex-Intuit, ex-PwC)
key_concerns: Category timing bets are inherently hard to verify this early
No named incumbent has publicly failed at this yet, so the 'why now' is inferred rather than evidenced
questions_for_founders: What would make QuickBooks or Xero unable to copy this in 12 months?
How do you define the category you're creating vs. just a feature of existing tools?
diligence_requirements: Competitive teardown of QuickBooks/Xero AI roadmap
3 customer reference calls on why they switched
